critique.bookDescription: One pass per scene. Slow and worth starting deliberately.
critique.doneWithEdits: {0} note(s) left as comments, {1} edit(s) proposed.
critique.lens.agentDescription: The reasons somebody would stop reading: a slow start, a voice that is not distinctive, a familiar premise.
critique.lens.continuityDescription: Only contradictions: facts, who knows what, details that change, time that does not add up.
critique.lens.developmentalDescription: Whether the scene works: who wants what, what is in the way, what has changed by the end.
critique.lens.firstReaderDescription: An ordinary reader, not an editor. Where they were confused, bored, unconvinced, or hooked.
critique.lens.lineDescription: The sentences only. Telling, filter words, rhythm, and words doing no work.
critique.lens.voiceDescription: Whether everyone sounds like themselves, and the narration sounds like the point-of-view character.
critique.sceneDescription: Reads the open scene and leaves its notes as comments on the sentences they are about.
critique.tooShort: There is not enough prose in this scene to critique.
inline.beatNeedsDirective: Say what should happen: type /beat followed by the beat, for example "/beat she finally admits it".
inline.nothingToContinue: There is nothing before the caret to continue from. Write a line first.

settings.aiAnthropicBaseUrlDesc: Leave as-is unless you route through a gateway or proxy.
settings.aiAnthropicKeyDesc: Used with the Anthropic provider, which calls the Messages API directly rather than driving a command-line tool.
settings.aiApiTokenDesc: Optional bearer token for LM Studio authentication.
settings.aiCopilotPathDesc: Path to the GitHub Copilot CLI executable. Use 'copilot' if it is on your PATH.
settings.aiEnabledDesc: Connect to an AI provider for AI-powered analysis and chat.
settings.aiGrammarCheckEnabledDesc: Use the AI to check grammar, punctuation, and style in the editor.
settings.aiPresetDesc: Fills in the base URL for a known OpenAI-compatible service. Every one of these speaks the same protocol as LM Studio, so only the address differs. Leave the URL alone to keep a hand-typed address.
settings.aiSystemPromptDesc: Custom system prompt sent to the AI. Leave empty to use the default prompt. Use {{LANGUAGE}} as a placeholder for the current UI language.
settings.backgroundAnalysisDesc: After you save a scene, analyse it quietly so the results are ready before a feature asks for them. Off by default because it uses the model without you starting it.
settings.knowledgeDesc: When enabled, the AI extracts what each character observed, learned, or said in every scene. 'Talk as character' uses this to roleplay with only the knowledge available up to a chosen scene. Generation runs once initially, then lazily for changed scenes.
settings.knowledgeMaxParallelDesc: Applies to every batch AI operation (story analysis, character knowledge scan, character chat). Set this to ≤ the LM Studio model's parallel-request slot count. The host serialises model-load probes so concurrent requests reuse the same loaded instance. Ignored when the Copilot provider is selected (forced to 1).

knowledgeMigration.description: Novalist now analyses each scene once and derives every character's knowledge from that single record. You have knowledge for {0} character(s) from the previous approach, which was generated per character instead.

choice.title: What should happen to it?
choice.help: Keeping it costs nothing now but mixes two kinds of data. Clearing it means a re-run, which is one pass per scene rather than per character.

knowledgeMigration.keepDesc: Old entries stay and are used where no scene record exists yet. They are replaced as scenes get analysed.
knowledgeMigration.clearDesc: Discards the old entries. Character knowledge stays empty until you run the scan again.
